name: Mac file walkthrough
description: Type short commands in a fresh Terminal window, create and read a small file, and leave it in the selected folder.
intro: Welcome. We will go from an empty Terminal prompt to a small greeting saved in the chosen folder.

steps.title: Change to the destination folder
steps.say: I focus the Terminal prompt, type cd to go to the destination, and print the working directory. The default destination is the Desktop.

steps.title: Create an empty file with touch
steps.say: I type touch followed by the new file name.

steps.title: Check the empty file with cat
steps.say: I type cat. The prompt returns with no file content.

steps.title: Write Hello Demio :D
steps.say: I type an echo command to append Hello Demio :D to the file.

steps.title: Read the greeting with cat
steps.say: I type cat again and read Hello Demio :D. The file stays in the destination folder.
